headlines.shortLinkText: Surging Jags hand Texans 11th loss in row

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw for three touchdowns and ran for another on Sunday, and the Cincinnati Bengals remained perfect at home and in control of the AFC North with a 42-28 victory over the Indianapolis Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton's 4 TDs lead Bengals in rout of Colts

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Matt Flynn threw for 258 yards and the Packers' struggling defense forced a key fourth-quarter turnover in a 22-21 win Sunday over the Atlanta Falcons to snap a five-game winless slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers convert key turnover, halt skid at 5

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Pats beat Browns 27-26 with TD after onside kick
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats beat Browns with TD after onside kick

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New York Jets

headlines.description: Smith leads Jets to 37-27 victory over Raiders
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith lifts Jets to victory over Raiders

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy rushed for a franchise-best 217 yards, including touchdowns of 57 and 40 yards, and the Philadelphia Eagles overcame two TD returns by Jeremy Ross to beat the Detroit Lions 34-20 in blizzard conditions Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy, Eagles top Lions in driving snow storm

headlines.description: Once the Miami Dolphins got used to the snow, the Pittsburgh Steelers were no problem.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins shake off snow, outlast Steelers

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Rookie Mike Glennon rebounded from one of his worst performances of the season to throw two touchdown passes and lead the Tampa Bay Buccaneers a 27-6 victory over the struggling Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Glennon bounces back as Bucs blow out Bills

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Chiefs thump Redskins 45-10 to break 3-game skid
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs thump Redskins to break 3-game skid

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw a 9-yard touchdown pass to rookie Marlon Brown with 4 seconds left, capping a flurry of scores on an icy field and giving the Baltimore Ravens a 29-26 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens stun Vikings with wild finish

headlines.description: Unbothered by the freezing weather, Matt Prater set an NFL record with a 64-yard field goal and Peyton Manning threw four more touchdown passes Sunday, lifting the Denver Broncos to a 51-28 victory over the Tennessee Titans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prater makes history as Broncos top Titans

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Cardinals beat Rams 30-10 to end NFC West skid
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer, Cards end 8-game NFC West skid

events.name: New York Giants at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers found rookie Keenan Allen for two of his three touchdown passes, and the San Diego Chargers beat Eli Manning and the New York Giants 37-14 Sunday to keep alive their long-shot playoff hopes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers bests Eli as Chargers dispatch Giants

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked a 22-yard field goal with 26 seconds remaining and the San Francisco 49ers held off the Seattle Seahawks 19-17 on Sunday.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 313 yards and four touchdowns and the New Orleans Saints beat Carolina 31-13 on Sunday night to regain sole possession of first place in the NFC South and snap the Panthers' winning streak at eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints bounce back, pound Panthers

headlines.description: Bears beat Cowboys 45-28 on Ditka Day
headlines.shortLinkText: McCown has 5 TDs as Bears bully Cowboys
